'''Blueflick''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Ignisnap]] at 3 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Blueflick is always eager to lick the trainer's fingers. It's cute but don't forget the fiery tail could burn a hole right through your sleeve."

Blueflick is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small, red lizard with a fiery tail and tan underbelly/chin. It has dark brown irises, blue pupils, and a blue tongue. Its feet are orange and it has orange accents bordering its underbelly.

Blueflick's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with pink.

== Evolution Trial ==
Blueflick's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 3 bronze stars/6 copies. To evolve it into [[Ignisnap]] you need to complete the following task:

* Shoot 1,000 pinballs.

== Trivia ==
* Blueflick's design is based on [https://wikipedia.org/wiki/Blue-tongued_skink blue-tongued lizards], a genus of skinks that are characterised by their eponymous blue-tipped tongues.
* Its original Bio used to say: "Its tongue may not be naturally blue. Some biologists suggests it may like eating blue popsicles."
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "'Feed Blueflicks blueberries regularly, otherwise the blue color of their tongues will fade.'--- 3-Piece Trainee Guide"
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "Blueflicks love to lick their own tails. The downside is that they get excited after and spout out flames in every direction."

==Strategy==
[[File:Blueflick Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Blueflick's attack range]]
Blueflick is a generic Fire DPS, so use it against Grass [[Zobos]] for the best results.
{{clear|left}}
